description: This file defines the EventBridgeEndpointMiddleware class, which reroutes EventBridge requests to proper endpoints by modifying request URIs based on provided configurations and command parameters. It is part of the AWS SDK for PHP, specifically handling endpoint resolution and request middleware logic for EventBridge.

classes.name: EventBridgeEndpointMiddleware
classes.description: Middleware class responsible for rerouting EventBridge requests to appropriate endpoints based on configuration and command parameters.

methods.name: wrap
methods.description: Static method to create a middleware handler wrapping function with specific configuration parameters.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing the middleware with handler, region, config, endpoint provider, and endpoint type.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Main handler method invoked to process and possibly modify outgoing requests based on command and configuration.

methods.name: isValidHostLabel
methods.description: Static method to validate if a string is a valid DNS host label.

methods.name: validateEndpointId
methods.description: Ensures the provided endpoint ID is valid and compatible with current configuration constraints.
